summary: Loads UI screen resource data from a file into a freshly allocated (pointer, size) buffer, then installs it as the caller's output pointer. The resource filename is built from an override path prefix (dword_5EC408) plus a per-screen name string from this[0xB0], with byte_5EA438 as the fallback for either part. The file is opened through AudioStreamOpen, its data section size is measured with ResourceLookupDispatcher between two seeks, a data buffer is allocated and its chunks are read out with ConditionalDispatchBasedOnFlag/sub_5665B0, any prior output buffer is freed, and the new buffer replaces it. The open resource is closed on return via SubCallWithConditionalFieldFree.

operations.description: Copy byte_5EA438[0] into the path buffer v14[0] and zero the remaining 0x1FC bytes plus the trailing v15/v16, seeding the buffer from the default directory prefix.
ZeroInitSmallStruct(v12) initializes the small resource_stream struct before use.
Select the screen name: v3 = this[44] (this+0xB0); if null, fall back to byte_5EA438.
Select the path override: v4 = dword_5EC408; if null, fall back to byte_5EA438.
StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck(v14, "%s%s", v4, v3) formats the full resource path as override_prefix + screen_name into the buffer.
If AudioStreamOpen(v12, v14, 1) succeeds, proceed with the load; otherwise skip the whole block and go straight to cleanup.
sub_566DB0(v12, 2) seeks to the end of the opened resource stream.
ResourceLookupDispatcher(v12) reads the end-of-stream position (v5) while the stream is at the end.
sub_566DB0(v12, 0) seeks back to the start of the resource stream.
Compute the data size v6 = end_position - start_position by subtracting a second ResourceLookupDispatcher(v12) reading from v5.
OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper(8) allocates the 8-byte output buffer struct (data pointer + size).
If the buffer struct was allocated, allocate v6 data bytes; otherwise leave the output struct null.
Write the allocated data pointer into v7[0] and the byte count v6 into v7[1], zeroing the first data byte.
ConditionalDispatchBasedOnFlag(v12, v13, 1) begins iteration over the resource data sections.
While ConditionalDispatchBasedOnFlag(v12, v11, 2) yields another chunk, sub_5665B0(v7, v11) copies that chunk into the loaded buffer.
If the caller's output *a2 is non-null, free its data pointer (*v9) and the struct itself with FreeWrapper_7bcf, then set *a2 = 0.
Install the freshly loaded buffer struct as the output: *a2 = v7.
SubCallWithConditionalFieldFree(v12) closes/cleans up the resource stream and its return value becomes this function's result.
